sections.title: RAG Applications for San Francisco Organizations
sections.description: Production RAG solutions for SF's leading organizations.

blocks.heading: FinTech Regulatory and Compliance RAG
paragraphs: For Stripe, Brex, Plaid, and SF's FinTech community navigating complex multi-jurisdiction licensing:

Multi-state money transmitter intelligence: RAG over state money transmitter license requirements, CFPB supervisory guidance, FinCEN BSA/AML regulations, and SEC payment-related guidance — enabling Stripe's and Brex's compliance teams to query the rapidly-evolving FinTech regulatory landscape in natural language rather than manually tracking hundreds of regulatory publications.

Open banking compliance RAG: RAG over CFPB open banking rulemaking, state-level data sharing requirements, and financial API standards for Plaid and the open banking API community navigating the CFPB's evolving Section 1033 framework.

Lending compliance intelligence: RAG over CFPB examination manuals, ECOA and FCRA regulations, and state lending laws for SF's consumer lending and BNPL community — enabling compliance teams to research lending law requirements across the multi-state licensing stack.
Cost: $40,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | FinCEN, CFPB logging context

blocks.heading: Biotech Scientific Literature RAG
paragraphs: For Genentech, Gilead, Vir Biotechnology, and the Bay Area's world-leading biotech research community:

Drug discovery literature RAG: RAG over PubMed, bioRxiv preprints, and proprietary research databases enabling Genentech's and Gilead's scientists to ask natural language research questions — 'What ADMET liabilities have been reported for this scaffold?' answered from decades of published research.

Clinical trial intelligence RAG: RAG over ClinicalTrials.gov, FDA approval history, and proprietary clinical data for Bay Area biotech's clinical development teams — competitive intelligence on trial designs, endpoint selections, and regulatory precedents.

Regulatory submission document RAG: RAG over FDA guidance documents, ICH guidelines, and prior submission history for Bay Area biotech's regulatory affairs teams — enabling natural language query of the complex regulatory framework governing drug development.
Default deployment: self-hosted Llama 3 on biotech corporate infrastructure — research IP never leaves the network.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | Self-hosted, IP protection

blocks.heading: Enterprise Knowledge Management RAG
paragraphs: For Salesforce, Dropbox, and SF's large enterprise technology companies:

Internal developer knowledge RAG: RAG over technical documentation, architecture decision records, and engineering runbooks for Salesforce's and Dropbox's large engineering organizations — enabling engineers to query institutional knowledge that accumulates in wikis and documents too vast to read.

Customer success intelligence: RAG over customer conversation history, support tickets, and product documentation for SF enterprise SaaS companies' customer success operations — enabling CSMs to query account history and relevant product knowledge simultaneously.
Sales intelligence RAG: RAG over proposal libraries, competitive intelligence, and product positioning documentation for enterprise sales teams querying institutional selling knowledge.
Cost: $35,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | CCPA, SSO integration

blocks.heading: Legal and IP RAG for Technology Law
paragraphs: For Wilson Sonsini, Fenwick & West, Cooley, and the technology law community in SF:

Technology startup legal precedent: RAG over technology company venture financing terms, executive compensation structures, and IP assignment agreement precedent for the law firms that handle the majority of Silicon Valley startup legal work.
Patent and IP portfolio intelligence: RAG over patent databases, prior art collections, and IP licensing history for the technology IP practices at SF's top technology law firms.
Startup regulatory intelligence: RAG over SEC crowdfunding regulations, state securities exemptions, and startup-specific regulatory guidance for the law firms advising SF's large startup community.
Cost: $40,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks | Privilege RBAC
